content: First increment (REQ-5): port effects::subsumes to a Verus-verified u8-bitset core in a new thermite-verified crate. Empirical b-vs-c resolution: mechanism (b) delegation/linking is infeasible for v1 (install vstd/builtin inherit workspace.lints, cfg(verus_keep_ghost), renamed verus_builtin crate, ensures-clause exec body is verus-driver-only) -> land mechanism (c): verus!{} proof behind cfg(verus_keep_ghost) + plain-Rust mirror (subsumes_masks/spec_subsumes_mask) that effects::subsumes delegates to, anchored by an exhaustive 65536-pair impl==spec equivalence test. Gauntlet step tests/verus_verify.rs runs real verus --no-cheating --crate-type=lib -> 8 verified, 0 errors; broken body -> 7 verified 1 errors (non-vacuous). 14 effects tests + L3 corpus preserved. Epic #60 stays open for the remaining 7 Tier-1 targets (REQ-2).
